extraction_notes.method: PyMuPDF text extraction with section detection from headings and entry splitting by bullet markers or blank-line paragraphs.
caveats: Line breaks and OCR/PDF text extraction artifacts were normalized into single spaces.
Section titles were preserved as extracted; some symbols may vary slightly from the original PDF typography.
Entries are stored as raw strings for robustness across heterogeneous citation formats.
